subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body: 4/5 — the rep was polite and explained the Wi-Fi field as a deferred onboarding step. the packet scanner asked me to double-check one thing before they process the hold: they believe the Wi-Fi field on my account is the chargeback-ratio rule. Is that correct? They said if it's the wrong rule the dispute gets rejected and bounces back to me, so I want to make sure before they file it. If it isn't that one, please say what the case actually shows so they file it correctly.
